messages.author: b04634d3f545924a
messages.subject: Fwd: Latin America R/Bioc Workshops
parts:
Dear group members,

I'm highly interested in contributing with courses/workshops/teaching organizing in general.  I’m a Spanish native speaker (I am from Argentina, but living in Barcelona). I was contacted recently from 2 different organisms in latin america to help in the organization of some workshop for the use of R/Bioconductor

1.- Colleagues from this platform (https://www.metadocencia.org/ ) are interested in collaborate for this proposal (https://chanzuckerberg.com/eoss/proposals/bioconductor-high-quality-training-and-support-for-a-worldwide-community/ ) in order to organize high quality courses in the Spanish language.

2.- I was invited to deliver a course on RNA-Seq data analysis using R/Bioconductor for a private platform (http://bioscienceappcourses.com/). They are wondering if Bioconductor can provide some sponsorship at least in terms of promotion / certificate / whatever

I will be looking forward to hearing from you, any help / advice / recommendation on how to proceed is really welcome,

Thanks in advance, have a nice week

Estefi

messages.author: 8986662aedb94e94
messages.subject: Re: Latin America R/Bioc Workshops
parts:
Dear Estefi, 

Thank you for your interest. 

We meet every second Monday of the month - next meeting is on Mon 13 Dec at 2pm (EU time). I suggest you join if you are available. As for your specific questions:

1. I think the best would be to discuss this with the group on Mon 13 Dec, and ideally also ask Aedin to join and/or organise another shorter meeting with Charlotte. Just let me know.

2. I can certainly not speak for the Bioconductor project at large, nor do I for the education committee, but I don't see why/how we should provide any certification or recommendation for a private platform. Again, open to discussion any time.

Best wishes,

Laurent
